scope: finite provenance-marked graph and synthetic binary evidence; no live neural model
source_grouping: one authentic trial or information origin is the independent unit; copies retain the origin ID

comparators.naive_echo: copies mapped to provenance self-loops; increment log(0.6/0.4) each
comparators.corrected_echo: same marked graph and edges; copied-source increments zero
comparators.fresh_independent: each signal has a new independent evidence ID; true conditionally independent observations
comparators.gauge_transform: add a vertex potential gradient; cycle integral invariant
comparators.flat_false: equal transcript distributions across worlds with opposite external semantic labels

primary_gates: for N>1, naive echo has N-1 cycles, each integral log(1.5) within 1e-10
for every N, corrected echo has same topology and vanishing cycle integrals
for every N, fresh evidence chain is flat
for N>1, echo expected log loss strictly increases with N, and fresh expected log loss is lower
for every N, true echo accuracy is exactly 0.6 and its MI is fixed at 1-h2(0.6)
finite graph gauge and indistinguishability tests pass
paired Monte Carlo at N=10 agrees with population echo accuracy within 0.01 and both losses within frozen tolerances

analysis.interpretation: cycle holonomy diagnoses path dependence only relative to independently verified provenance marks

exclusions: no novel general-purpose spectral theorem claimed
no behavioral control or RSI-risk certification
no new authorization level for signed reward or weight edits
no model weights or externally hosted experiment
